info.title: @benchmark/todo-backend
info.description: NestJS, Nestia, and Prisma backend for benchmark-todo

post.summary: End only the current authenticated session; other account sessions remain valid
post.description: End only the current authenticated session; other account sessions remain valid.

post.summary: End every session belonging to the current account
post.description: End every session belonging to the current account.

put.summary: Replace the password after proving the current password; all sessions end
put.description:
Replace the password after proving the current password; all sessions end.
Refuses an incorrect, reused, or invalid password.

post.summary: Permanently delete the account, profile, sessions, Todos, trash, and history
post.description:
Permanently delete the account, profile, sessions, Todos, trash, and history.
Refuses an incorrect current password.

post.summary: Register a private account and issue its first session
post.description:
Register a private account and issue its first session.

Duplicate canonical email, credential, and display-name violations are
refused without creating any account state.

requestBody.description: Registration credentials and initial profile name

201.description: The new authenticated session and private profile

post.summary: Log in with an existing email and password
post.description:
Log in with an existing email and password.

Unknown emails and wrong passwords have the same generic refusal.

post.summary: Continue one valid session with its refresh token
post.description: Continue one valid session with its refresh token.

post.summary: Start forgotten-password recovery without disclosing account existence
post.description:
Start forgotten-password recovery without disclosing account existence.

An existing account receives a recorded email effect; the response is
identical when no account matches.

requestBody.description: Email identity to notify when it exists

post.summary: Consume the one-time email proof and issue a replacement session
post.description:
Consume the one-time email proof and issue a replacement session.
Refuses an unknown, expired, consumed, or incorrect proof.

requestBody.description: Email, delivered proof, and replacement password

200.description: Literal marker used by local and deployed health probes.

get.summary: Return the current account's private display profile
get.description: Return the current account's private display profile.

put.summary: Replace only the current account's display name
put.description:
Replace only the current account's display name.
Refuses a blank or overlong trimmed name.

patch.summary: Browse the authenticated owner's active Todos with completion filtering and stable date sorting
patch.description:
Browse the authenticated owner's active Todos with completion filtering and stable date sorting.
Refuses unsupported filters, sort choices, or pagination values.

200.description: One page of compact active Todo summaries

post.summary: Create an incomplete active Todo owned permanently by the authenticated user
post.description:
Create an incomplete active Todo owned permanently by the authenticated user.
Refuses invalid content or an incoherent date interval.

requestBody.description: Todo content and optional planning dates

get.summary: View one active Todo owned by the authenticated user
get.description:
View one active Todo owned by the authenticated user.
Returns `404` for absent, trashed, or other-owned targets.

put.summary: Edit active Todo content and append one immutable history entry atomically
put.description:
Edit active Todo content and append one immutable history entry atomically.
Refuses invalid, no-op, stale, trashed, absent, or other-owned edits.

requestBody.description: Changed content and version read at edit start

delete.summary: Move an owned active Todo into trash without changing content or history
delete.description:
Move an owned active Todo into trash without changing content or history.
Refuses an already trashed, absent, or other-owned target.

put.summary: Mark an owned active Todo complete; repeating the state is idempotent
put.description: Mark an owned active Todo complete; repeating the state is idempotent.

put.summary: Mark an owned active Todo incomplete; repeating the state is idempotent
put.description: Mark an owned active Todo incomplete; repeating the state is idempotent.

get.summary: View the complete newest-first content-edit history of an owned active or trashed Todo
get.description:
View the complete newest-first content-edit history of an owned active or trashed Todo.
Completion, trash, and restore transitions never appear as history entries.

patch.summary: Browse the authenticated owner's retained Todos newest-trash-first
patch.description:
Browse the authenticated owner's retained Todos newest-trash-first.
Refuses unsupported pagination values and excludes active or other-owned Todos.

200.description: One page of compact trashed Todo summaries

get.summary: Inspect one owned trashed Todo before recovery or permanent deletion
get.description:
Inspect one owned trashed Todo before recovery or permanent deletion.
Returns `404` for active, absent, or other-owned targets.

delete.summary: Permanently delete one trashed Todo and every attached history entry
delete.description:
Permanently delete one trashed Todo and every attached history entry.
Refuses an active, absent, or other-owned target.

put.summary: Restore the same Todo identity to active work without adding history
put.description:
Restore the same Todo identity to active work without adding history.
Refuses an active, absent, or other-owned target.

IOperationResult.description: Successful acknowledgement for stateful commands without a resource body.

success.description: Always true when the operation completed.

IUser.IDeleteAccount.description: Password confirmation for terminal account deletion.

IUser.description: Private profile shown only to its authenticated owner.

IUser.IAuthorized.description: Authentication material returned by join, login, and refresh.

token.description: Tokens also issued through the standard Nestia authorization header hook.

email.description: Canonicalized by the server after validation.

displayName.description: Trimmed by the server and bounded to one through 100 characters.

IUser.IRefresh.description: Refresh input for a still-valid session.

IUser.IRecoveryRequest.description: Starts a non-disclosing email recovery journey.

email.description: Email whose ownership should receive a proof.

IUser.IRecoveryConfirm.description: Consumes the proof delivered to the registered email.

proof.description: One-time proof from the recorded email effect.

IPage.IPagination.description: Position and size of one page within the complete result set.

current.description: One-indexed page represented by this response.

limit.description: Maximum records requested for this page.

IPageITodo.ISummary.description: One page of a larger result set.

pagination.description: Position and size of this page within the complete result set.

data.description: Records returned for the current page.

limit.description: Maximum number of records returned per page.

ITodo.description: One private Todo, including its current lifecycle state.

description.description: Full description, or null when empty.

dueDate.description: Date-only planning due date, or null.

trashedAt.description: Most recent trash-entry instant, or null.

version.description: Content version used to reject stale edits.

ITodo.IUpdate.description: Partial content edit with optimistic version.

description.description: New description, including null to clear.

startDate.description: New start date, including null to clear.

dueDate.description: New due date, including null to clear.

version.description: Version read when the edit began.

title.description: New title when title participated in the edit.

description.description: New description when changed; null means explicitly cleared.

startDate.description: New start date when changed; null means explicitly cleared.

dueDate.description: New due date when changed; null means explicitly cleared.

IPageITodo.ITrashSummary.description: One page of a larger result set.

pagination.description: Position and size of this page within the complete result set.

data.description: Records returned for the current page.

ITodo.ITrashSummary.description: Compact trash-list projection, including the recovery timestamp.

IPage.IRequest.description: Pagination controls accepted by list operations.

limit.description: Maximum number of records returned per page.
